summary: Correspondence Attachments feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (list, upload, 15MB cap, /api/files download w/ and w/o auth, multi-faculty curriculum attach -> 3 PDFs (dept without curriculum skipped), empty faculty list 400, no-data faculty -> Arabic 400, delete + 404 on re-delete, ISSUED -> 409 for upload/curriculum, unauth list rejected). Frontend (Playwright, admin): details page card shows count; upload via hidden input adds row with filename/size and working download link (200); curriculum modal renders 2 faculty checkboxes, multi-select 'إرفاق (2)' produced 3 PDFs with 'خطة دراسية — كلية/قسم' badges; delete with confirm dialog removes row; compose screen shows same card (shared state) above editor; ISSUED correspondence shows card read-only (no upload/curriculum/delete buttons) on both details and compose; negative case (mocked faculty with no curriculum) surfaces Arabic error in corr-att-error.

minor.issue: Only checks that the JWT is valid. It does not check whether the user can see the correspondence, so any logged-in user with the storage_path can download any attachment. Soft-deleting an attachment does not set files.is_deleted=true, so a deleted attachment can still be downloaded from its old link.
No Content-Disposition filename is sent, so a downloaded file is saved under its UUID name instead of original_filename.
No de-duplication: attaching the same faculty twice creates duplicate PDFs for each department.

issues: On attach failure the error (corr-att-error) shows in the card behind the dimmed modal overlay, not inside the modal, so the user can easily miss it. Show the error inside the modal.
fmtSize shows '0 كيلوبايت' for files under 512 bytes. Show bytes, or a minimum of '<1 كيلوبايت'.

action_items: Optional: render the curriculum-attach error inside the modal
Optional: mark db.files is_deleted=true when an attachment is soft-deleted, and/or check correspondence access in /api/files for correspondence_attachments
Optional: return Content-Disposition with original_filename on file serve
Optional: fix the size display for very small files
critical_code_review_comments: CorrAttachments reads the token once via useAuthStore.getState() and does not subscribe to it. Acceptable, but if the token refreshes, the download links keep the old token until the component remounts.
upload_attachment reads the whole file into memory before the 15MB check. Acceptable at this size.
Attachments of a soft-deleted draft stay in correspondence_attachments (no cascade). Harmless, but leaves orphan records.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ drafts 'TEST_مرفقات pytest' (via the pytest fixture) and 'TEST_مرفقات UI' (6aef4efbb1657caebacc3ee9). Both were soft-deleted afterwards. ISSUED corr 6ac5048305549193bba94794 was used read-only. Corr 6ac5206a80c5f91155a6d15b was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with '-p no:xdist' because the tests share class state in order. In the DB every faculty has curriculum data (كلية الشريعة: الشريعة والقانون=16 courses, عقيدة=1, قسم اختبار=0; كلية البنات: الدراسات الإسلامية=4), so the no-data negative case was tested with a fake faculty id: page.route mock of /api/faculties in the UI, and id 000...0 via the API. Login on web uses inputs with placeholders 'اسم المستخدم / رقم القيد / الرقم المرجعي' and 'كلمة المرور'.
